Privacy Policy · Contact

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

What SoCloudyBro is

SoCloudyBro is a private, invite-based messaging platform. It lets registered users send end-to-end encrypted messages, make voice and video calls, and share updates within a trusted community.

What data we collect

  • Account data: Your name, a user number, and optionally an email address and profile photo.
  • Messages: Stored encrypted in Firebase. Content is only readable on your device with your encryption key.
  • Usage data: Basic connection metadata (timestamps, online status) to deliver messages.
  • Google sign-in: If you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account name and email. We do not store your Google password.

How we use your data

Your data is used solely to operate SoCloudyBro. We do not sell, share, or use your data for advertising. Messages are end-to-end encrypted and we cannot read them.

Data storage

Data is stored in Google Firebase (Europe West region). We do not operate our own servers. Firebase's data processing terms apply.

Your rights

You can delete your account at any time from Settings. This removes your profile and messages from our database.

Contact

Questions? Email support@socloudybro.vercel.app

⚠️ Delete Account

This starts a 7-day countdown. Your account will be deactivated immediately and permanently deleted after that — messages you've sent will show as "Deleted User" rather than being pulled from other people's conversations. You can cancel any time before the countdown ends.

Cleared

Their account number, password, email, sign-in and two-factor setup, any connected Google account and linked Syntax Account (so those stay working as ways to sign in and keep their “Playing…” badge), account creation date, blocked list, signed-in devices, and every message, chat and group they're part of.
